---
title: "Veil"
subtitle: "One deck for many audiences"
author: "Mickaël Canouil"
format:
  revealjs:
    output-file: example-slides.html
  html: default
filters:
  - veil
revealjs-plugins:
  - veil
extensions:
  veil:
    groups:
      - name: advanced
        level: 1
        shown: true
        label: Advanced
      - name: expert
        level: 2
        shown: false
        label: Expert
      - name: backup
        shown: false
        label: Backup
---

## Why Veil

One deck can serve a short talk and a long talk.

- Press `u` to open the Veil popover.
- Press `]` to show more content.
- Press `[` to show less content.

## Going further {.veil group="advanced"}

This slide is for an advanced audience.
It is shown at level 1 and above.

Some details are [only for experts]{.veil group="expert"}.

## The proof {.veil group="expert"}

This slide is shown at level 2.

::: {.callout-note .veil group="expert"}
A note for experts.
:::

## Summary

Every audience sees this slide.

## Backup: raw numbers {.veil group="advanced backup"}

This slide needs both `advanced` and `backup`.
The `backup` group has no level, so turn it on in the Veil popover.
